specs.Other Special Features of the Product: Ergonomic, Power-Saving, Retro Design, Round Key

features: 【⌨️ Stylish Retro Round Key Keyboard】 Designed with elegant round keycaps that combine classic typewriter-inspired aesthetics with modern typing comfort. The compact layout provides a comfortable and enjoyable typing experience for work, study, and everyday computing.

【🖱️ High-Precision 1200 DPI Optical Mouse】 Includes a responsive wireless optical mouse with up to 1200 DPI tracking for smooth cursor control, accurate navigation, and reliable performance across office tasks, browsing, and daily productivity.

【📶 Stable 2.4GHz Wireless Connectivity】 Enjoy lag-free wireless performance through a shared 2.4GHz USB receiver. The keyboard and mouse connect instantly with reliable transmission, providing a clutter-free workspace without cable restrictions.

【💻 Wide Compatibility & Compact Design】 Compatible with Windows XP, 7, 8, and 10 systems. The compact keyboard and lightweight mouse are designed to save desk space while offering comfortable operation for desktops, laptops, home offices, and study environments.

【⚡ Plug & Play with Power-Saving Technology】 Simply connect the USB receiver and start working immediately without additional software or drivers. Intelligent power-saving functionality helps extend battery life, making it ideal for home and office use.
